original_request:
Build a browser-based ticket/request tracking application for a small IT company.

Each request must contain:

- client name
- phone or email
- company, optional
- problem description
- priority:
  - low
  - normal
  - high
  - urgent
- status

Required statuses:

- new
- in progress
- waiting for client
- completed
- closed

Required behavior:

- create a request
- display requests in a common list
- open/view an existing request
- edit/update an existing request
- add comments to a request
- delete a request only after confirmation

Dashboard counters must show:

- new requests
- requests in progress
- urgent requests
- requests closed today

Search must work by:

- client name
- phone
- email
- problem text

Filters must support:

- status
- priority

The user interface must be:

- modern
- dark
- usable on desktop
- usable on tablet

Administration scope:

- one local admin
- no complex user-management system

Data:

- persistent local storage

Delivery requirements:

- real application startup
- real working controls/buttons
- logical application behavior
- automated tests for main functionality
- Windows installation/run instructions

Technology:

Analyze the requirements first and choose the appropriate implementation stack.

assumptions: Generated project should run locally from its project root
FastAPI app exposes an ASGI app object named app
explicit_constraints: delete a request only after confirmation
inferred_requirements: Root README.md with install, run, and test instructions
Python dependency file must match imports
Credential requirements must be documented in .env.example without real secrets
